question: A student born on 20 November 2013 signs up on 5 October 2026. What does this return?
options: true, which is right. They are 12.
false, which is right. They are 13.
true, which is wrong. They are 13.
false, which is wrong. They are 12 and need consent.
reason: It subtracts years only. 2026 minus 2013 is 13, but their birthday has not come yet this year, so they are 12.
